Map: § SM-1 · ATTENDANCE DAY — punch to disposition to payroll input (demo points 1, 12, 13)

System (Nucleus): Ingests, de-duplicates, stores the raw event immutably
Note: Clock drift corrected; raw value retained

Employee / worker: Punches OUT 20:30, IN 21:15, OUT 03:20 next morning

System (Nucleus): Assigns all four events to ONE attendance day dated the shift start
Note: The single most common error in this domain

System (Nucleus): Pairs into two segments; writes the 45-minute dinner gap as its own break row
Note: Break report exists because breaks are rows

System (Nucleus): Gross 19:20; break 0:45 recorded not deducted; OT 7:20 against the 12h shift
Note: Gate-to-gate for this client — configuration

System (Nucleus): Resolves day type, then grace, lates, thresholds, long-night relief
Note: Day type FIRST, always

System (Nucleus): Stamps computed_at and ruleset version, emits the computed event

Manager: Sees the day in team history and approves the overtime

System (Nucleus): Tags the OT record to the off-cycle run and hands the day to payroll inputs

Map: § SM-2 · EXCEPTION AND REGULARISATION (demo point 1, agent pattern)

System (Nucleus): Pairing fails; raises an unpaired-punch exception
Note: Never silently discarded

Agent: Attendance Steward triages, proposes a regularisation from roster and device evidence with a dry-run diff

Manager: Approves, amends or rejects the proposal
Note: Auto-resolve only under the tenant threshold

HR / admin: Can edit at any stage, logged with reason

System (Nucleus): Recomputes the day, closes the exception, writes the delta

Employee / worker: Sees the corrected day and the reason

Map: § SM-3 · LEAVE — apply, validate, approve, early return (demo points 5, 7)

System (Nucleus): Projects balance from the ledger; runs combination and cap rules BEFORE the chain
Note: CL+EL blocked here, with the rule named
Sequential, each with an SLA

System (Nucleus): Debits the ledger against named credits; updates the calendar; raises the payroll input

HR / admin: Records the early return and closes the request
Note: HR edit right, logged with actor and reason

System (Nucleus): ONE transaction: reversal row referencing the original debit + attendance recompute
Note: Split them and the payslip disagrees with the ledger

Employee / worker: Sees the re-credited balance and Present days

System (Nucleus): Checks the monthly ceiling in the SERVICE: 240 minutes, 2 instances
Note: Same rule whichever channel it arrives on

System (Nucleus): Deducts the gap as a break, credits the approved minutes back before thresholds
Note: Net hours unchanged by an approved pass

System (Nucleus): Rejected at validation, reason names the ceiling already used

Map: § SM-5 · PAYROLL CYCLE INCLUDING THE OFF-CYCLE OT RUN (demo points 10, 15)

Note: Late punches now raise exceptions, not changes

System (Nucleus): Writes the hashed snapshot: inputs, rule pack versions, config
Runs the pre-audit rule checks, then statistical checks

Agent: Payroll Preparer classifies each flag and drafts resolutions
Note: Propose only. Always.

HR / admin: Resolves or waives each flag; CRITICAL flags block

System (Nucleus): Runs the gross-to-net DAG; wage base with the 50% add-back; daily-wage node where the class says so
Recovers loan instalments, respecting the net-pay floor

Note: Blocked if any component lacks a GL mapping

System (Nucleus): Generates the bank file with a checksum
Note: Total verified out of band, dual control

System (Nucleus): Emits the dimensioned journal
Note: Split at employee level before aggregation

HR / admin: Creates run PR-…-02, run_type off_cycle_ot, pay date 07 Oct
Note: Its own approval, bank file and journal

Employee / worker: Opens the payslip and picks the run
Note: Run selector everywhere

Map: § SM-6 · LOAN — eligibility, guarantors, sanction, recovery, release (demo point 9)

System (Nucleus): GET /loans/eligibility: active loan? guarantor lock? ceiling 4x or 6x basic?
Note: One service method, four consumers

System (Nucleus): Rejects with reasons, or proceeds
Note: E1041 rejected: he guarantees an active loan

System (Nucleus): Locks the guarantors — now ineligible themselves

HR / admin: Sanction chain approves; director may override with rules waived recorded

System (Nucleus): Registers the deduction node; payroll recovers monthly above the net floor
Outstanding hits zero → closes the loan → WRITES the guarantor release rows
Note: Without the release row they are blocked forever

Map: § SM-7 · EXIT — clearance in parallel with notice, F&F on the last working day (demo point 16)

System (Nucleus): Instantiates the clearance checklist for this worker class and location
Note: Plant and head office templates differ

HR / admin: Nine items across departments run IN PARALLEL with notice, four blocking

System (Nucleus): Asset register drives the blocking items; unreturned asset becomes a recovery line

Agent: Exit Coordinator chases owners on SLA and assembles the F&F pack
Note: Prepare; a human releases

System (Nucleus): All blocking items closed → F&F run unblocks (same lock as the payroll input lock)

HR / admin: Approves and settles on the last working day

Employee / worker: Receives settlement, relieving letter and the alumni record
